messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Deployment health degraded for service `inference-api` (eu-west-2). Canary stuck provisioning, 95% rollout paused, error rate spike ~10%. roll_id=deploy-2026-03-15-22. Paging #eng-oncall.
alex: Oncall responding — looking now. Seeing 503/504 spike from canary pods in eu-west-2.
sasha: I pulled the pod logs: several `failed to attach volume: timeout` and `prewarm hook exited 1` around the same time for canary-*/7.
alex: Checking k8s events + node messages. Could be volume attach race or a node-level flapping.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline automatically PAUSED at 95% due to failing readiness checks. To rollback run: `rwt rollback deploy-2026-03-15-22 --region eu-west-2`.
maria: Do we have a feature-flag for the new backfill-prefetch path? If we can toggle it off it might stop the hot path without rollback.
alex: Good idea. Toggling flag for EU: `ff toggle backfill-prefetch false --env=eu-west-2` — executing now.
alex: :white_check_mark: flag toggled off for eu-west-2. Observability: errors dropping from ~10% -> ~4% in the last 90s but still above baseline (0.5%).
sasha: Still seeing an internal request queue backlog on canary pods. The new code path increased memory/worker usage and some pods went OOMKilled earlier.
jordan: Given there's still elevated errors and queueing, I'll start a controlled rollback to the previous stable revision for eu-west-2. Initiating now: `rwt rollback start --id deploy-2026-03-15-22 --region eu-west-2`.
jordan: Rollback started; pipeline shows drain -> rollback -> reconcile.
oncall-bot: UPDATE: rollback triggered by @jordan. Expected downtime window: a few minutes per pod as we roll back canaries.
alex: Error rate trending back down to baseline over the last 6 minutes. Latency normalizing. Customer impact: short window (~8 minutes) of increased 503s for EU customers, small percentage of requests; no data exposure or degraded embeddings observed.
maria: Acknowledge handoff — I'll take night on-call at 23:00 UTC and monitor the eu-west-2 rollout. Runbook open, dashboard pinned. Escalation criteria: error rate >2% sustained for 5m or queue depth >1000.
sasha: Quick notes for follow-up: root cause likely a race between prewarm hooks and volume attach combined with an untested memory hotspot in the new backfill-prefetch path. Action items: (1) increase attach timeout and add retry, (2) add autoscaler headroom for canaries, (3) tighten rollout pause threshold from 95%->90% and add extra health checks for prewarm.
alex: Agree. I'll file a postmortem and include sample logs and timeline. Also add a short mitigation step in the deployment playbook to toggle the flag quickly.
jordan: Thanks team. Leaving rollback in place and monitoring. Will close once metrics stable for 15m.
maria: Monitoring — will escalate if anything spikes. Good handoff.
alex: :thumbsup: Closing incident thread; follow-up ticket will be created (ENG-xxxx).
